title: Stage a shared contributor bootstrap without a parallel authority system
problem: The founder authorized preparing GitHub updates. Five inspected default branches lack a root AGENTS.md although the kernel already contains a recursive protocol and collaboration records. This constitutional decision proposes contributor obligations; adoption and merge remain pending. Five roles below are one model's explicitly labeled analytical lenses, not independent agents or reviews.
baseline: Kernel main bcbb1ab4 contains the merged records-only #82 package. No new runtime is needed to make that record discoverable. See BOOTSTRAP_EVIDENCE.md for the exact inspected refs.

alternatives.name: Baseline
alternatives.description: Existing scattered instructions and collaboration records
disadvantages: No common root AGENTS entry point in five inspected main trees
alternatives.revival_evidence: Retain if additional receipt burden harms handoff quality

alternatives.name: Simplest viable alternative
alternatives.description: Only add root pointers to existing protocol
disadvantages: No inspectable read-set or revision mismatch check
alternatives.revival_evidence: Use if pilot metadata check costs more than it prevents

alternatives.name: Strongest competing architecture
alternatives.description: Central authenticated work service with automatic context loading and leases
advantages: Could enforce startup at configured execution boundary
disadvantages: New service, credentials and authority integration; much larger blast radius
alternatives.revival_evidence: A separately authorized requirement and working threat model justify a service

alternatives.name: Discussion-only
alternatives.description: Put instructions in a pinned discussion
disadvantages: No universal tool discovery or versioned context binding
alternatives.revival_evidence: Use as intake surface after founder enables and pins it

alternatives.name: Reversible experiment
alternatives.description: One canonical guide, thin tool pointers and central reusable metadata checker across five draft PRs
advantages: Bounded and revertible; no production runtime dependencies
disadvantages: Declared reading and review can be false; requires adoption/settings
alternatives.revival_evidence: Pilot supports retention only if handoff quality improves

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Existing records remain but each worker must rediscover how to start.

roles.position: Preserve the directive and capability horizon without treating metaphor or a source pointer as authority.
material_concerns: Potential silent retirement of old intent

roles.position: Add navigation and reusable checking around the existing protocol, not another runtime or canonical rulebook.
Treat every receipt as untrusted self-report; a passing check must not imply understanding or authorization.
Use stdlib metadata checks with no checkout or secrets; keep consumers pinned and rollback sequenced.
Preserve negative results and privacy; do not upload unrelated chats or fake independent review.

evidence.claim: Existing kernel collaboration protocol is present; root AGENTS is absent in the five inspected main trees.
evidence.finding: Use additive entry points and preserve existing rules.

counterevidence.claim: A file and a self-reported receipt cannot force all agents to read or act correctly.
counterevidence.finding: Do not claim runtime enforcement; require configured clients and independent review.

pass_1.intended_outcome: Any authorized new worker finds existing intent, ownership, evidence and handoff with minimal reconstruction.

advantages.statement: Existing protocol already preserves alternatives and dissent
advantages.amplified_value: Route all workers to it rather than fork it
Bind declared read-set and PR scope to full source/base/head revisions

disadvantages.statement: Workers may fabricate a read receipt
disadvantages.redesigned_response: State self-report limits; match base/head and guide pin; retain independent human review.

disadvantages.statement: New process may overburden tiny changes
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Lightweight lane omits two-pass ceremony; test five pilot completions before expanding.

disadvantages.statement: A central guide can become stale or inaccessible
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Pin source version; refresh current authorized rulings; record access failure and keep safe work bounded.

disadvantages.statement: New SOPs could silently ratify unresolved ownership or activate automation
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Keep existing protocol and ownership map intact; draft-only adoption; no runtime/settings writes.

disadvantages.statement: Workers may collide or overwrite experimental branches
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Bounded claims, explicit base SHA, recheck overlaps, dedicated branches; no force push or deletion.

comparisons.baseline: No common entry point despite existing records
comparisons.do_nothing: Zero churn but repeated discovery work
comparisons.simplest_viable_alternative: Pointers only; preferred fallback if receipt harms throughput
comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: Authenticated orchestration service deferred because it exceeds this task
comparisons.reversible_experiment: Five draft PRs, metadata-only check and a five-completion adoption review

rejected_alternatives.name: Discussion-only
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: Not reliably discovered by coding tools or bound to revisions
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: Use it as a pinned intake link alongside the versioned file

rejected_alternatives.name: Central authenticated work service
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: Unnecessary runtime, credential and authority expansion
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: A later authorized experiment proves simpler pointers are insufficient

pass_2.attack_summary: Attack the candidate as deployed: declaration fraud, procedural overhead, stale pins, false ratification and collision claims.

new_weaknesses.statement: PR authors can forge evidence/review references
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Checker describes itself as metadata-only; required human review remains separate

new_weaknesses.statement: Squash/deletion can make pinned unmerged workflow commits difficult to retain
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Prefer merge-preserved commit or reviewed repin; keep source commit reachable

new_weaknesses.statement: Deleting a required check can freeze merges
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Remove only the new ruleset requirement before reverting its workflow

residual_risks.mitigation: Independent review and explicit evidence limits, not automatic trust

residual_risks.risk: Startup not configured in every agent client
residual_risks.mitigation: New-session test and saved instruction for unsupported clients

residual_risks.risk: Pilot creates more ceremony than value
residual_risks.mitigation: Five-completion comparison and simplify to pointer-only if necessary
residual_risks.review_trigger: Rework increases or correct first-action time worsens

dissent.handling: Preserved as limits and explicit adoption conditions; no independent reviewer consensus is claimed.

entries.position: Do not call the metadata check enforcement of reading or authority.
entries.rationale: An author controls the receipt content and can provide a plausible false account.
entries.evidence_threshold: Any claim that a passing check attests comprehension or authorization triggers correction and blocks promotion.
entries.review_trigger: PR or documentation overclaims the check

migration_plan: Current chat permits draft preparation only. Review kernel package, preserve exact source commit on merge, then review/merge four pinned consumer PRs. Configure required checks and client startup separately. Existing experiments and rules are untouched.

steps: Before adoption, leave drafts unmerged and retain evidence.
After adoption, remove only the newly required status requirement before reverting its workflow.
Revert scoped pointers/checks, preserve intent, dissent and negative pilot evidence.

kill_criteria: A change creates or claims new runtime authority.
A workflow reads secrets, checks out untrusted code or executes PR text.
Existing history, unrelated work or failed evidence is destroyed.
Staged adoption is represented as completed rollout.
review_trigger: Human review of the coordinated draft PRs; then five completed pilot PRs
